name: Kupala
source:
Little Anya and her family journey to her grandmother’s aged house on Ivan Kupala night – when the boundary between worlds thins. That night, ancient creatures awaken, hungering for the living.

[From [url=https://tmbaig.itch.io/kupala-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伊万·库帕拉之夜，当世界之间的界限变得模糊时，小安雅和她的家人前往祖母的老房子。那天晚上，古老的生物苏醒了，渴望活人。

[来自[url=https://tmbaig.itch.io/kupala-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
